pass_a_method.review_scope: Full replay 1-second frame sequence for each eligible race was reviewed before any Batch3 BANTE_FOLLOW or INITIATIVE_CONFLICT outcome was entered.
pass_a_method.fail_closed_role_adjudication: A visible forward move was not admitted unless the pre-anchor visual state itself resolved the actor as a line leader or solo rider. Historical post-event race pages, finish order, payout, odds, and downstream follow/conflict labels were not used to create anchors.

frozen_attack_anchors.visual_basis: At 40s car 7 is visibly at the head of a coherent outside line with car 2 immediately behind. At 41s car 7 begins a sustained forward/outside move toward the occupied forward group, continuing across ordered frames 42s and later.

zero_anchor_or_fail_closed_races.reason: A sustained forward move by car 1 was visible around 30s, but the pre-anchor 1-second visual state did not independently resolve line-leader/solo status without relying on non-point-in-time lineage information. Candidate therefore not admitted.
Full pre-terminal review did not resolve a qualifying sustained initiative-attack anchor under the frozen definition.

A sustained forward move by car 5 was visible around 34s, but the pre-anchor visual state did not independently resolve line-leader/solo status to the fail-closed threshold. Candidate therefore not admitted.

A forward challenge by car 3 was visible around 34s, but pre-anchor visual line-role resolution was not sufficiently independent of later formation to satisfy the fail-closed role requirement. Candidate therefore not admitted.

A sustained outside move by car 7 was visible around 34s, but the pre-anchor visual state did not independently establish solo/line-leader status to the required threshold. Candidate therefore not admitted.

explicit_nonanchors: No anchor is created merely to preserve an expected event count.
Ambiguous potential attacks remain non-anchors rather than being promoted using downstream BANTE_FOLLOW or INITIATIVE_CONFLICT behavior.
No new anchor is created from terminal-sprint overtaking.
terminal_rule: The single Batch3 attack anchor above is frozen before Batch3 BANTE_FOLLOW or INITIATIVE_CONFLICT PRESENT/ABSENT/UNKNOWN labeling. Pass B may not add, delete, retime, or substitute Batch3 attack anchors in response to downstream outcomes.
